GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID.description: GCP organization id (numeric) whose Security Command Center surface should be queried. Accepts a bare numeric id (e.g. 123456789012) or the fully-qualified organizations/{id} form. Used as the {org} segment in the SCC v2 parent string organizations/{org}/sources/{src}/locations/{loc}. The service account behind GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS must hold roles/securitycenter.findingsViewer (or equivalent custom role granting securitycenter.findings.list) at the organization scope.

GCP_SOURCE.description: Optional SCC source id (numeric) to narrow the query to a single Security Command Center source. Accepts a bare numeric id or the sources/{id} form. Blank queries every source the IAM principal can read by using the wildcard sources/- in the parent string.

SCC_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Optional client-side severity floor. Accepts info | low | medium | high | critical (plus the SCC synonyms: informational, important / major, moderate, minor, none / unspecified / undefined / severity_unspecified). When set to medium or above the floor is also pushed into the server-side filter as severity="..." disjunctions; below that the floor is applied client-side after each finding has been bucketed. Defaults to info (no filtering).

SCC_STATE.description: Optional SCC state filter (ACTIVE | INACTIVE). Forwarded as state="..." in the SCC filter clause. Synonyms accepted (OPEN -> ACTIVE, CLOSED / RESOLVED -> INACTIVE). Blank returns every state the IAM principal can read.

name: gcp_scc
title: Google Cloud Security Command Center
description: Google Cloud Security Command Center v2 vendor-native CSPM importer. Pulls security findings from GCP Security Command Center via the canonical google-cloud-securitycenter SDK (SecurityCenterClient.list_findings) and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON to stdout. Each affected GCP asset (resolved from finding.resourceName — the canonical //{service}.googleapis.com/projects/{proj}/{scope}/{loc}/{type}/{name} shape — or the per-result resource blob returned by SCC v2) becomes one Faraday host (synthetic 0.0.0.0 ip because SCC findings live on GCP assets, not on IPs); per-resource findings attach as Faraday vulnerabilities — one per Finding name with [CNAPP] engine prefix. Severity is normalised from SCC's CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/UNDEFINED/SEVERITY_UNSPECIFIED enum with CVSS v3 base-score bucketing (vulnerability.cve.cvssv3.baseScore) as a fallback when only a numeric score is present. Status mapped from finding.state (ACTIVE -> open, INACTIVE -> closed) and finding.mute (MUTED -> risk-accepted). CVE list harvested via a strict CVE-\d{4}-\d+ regex from vulnerability.cve.id + cves[].id + vulnerability.cve.references plus free-form title / description / category / sourceProperties token-scan. Refs include CWE-* from vulnerability.cve.cwes, externalUri (SCC console deep-link), SCC-Finding (canonicalName) / SCC-Category / SCC-Class / SCC-Source / SCC-Vuln / SCC-Exploitation / SCC-UpstreamFix pivots, MITRE-Tactic / MITRE-Technique pivots from mitreAttack, and Compliance: {standard} {version} {id} pivots from compliances[]. Resolution is built from finding.nextSteps (SCC's canonical operator-facing guidance) with a sourceProperties.Recommendation / Explanation fallback. Auth: GCP Security Command Center v2 uses the standard Google Application Default Credentials chain. A service account with roles/securitycenter.findingsViewer is required; credentials are exposed as a service-account JSON key file whose path is set in GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS. The SDK picks the file up automatically via ADC; the executor validates that the path exists and is readable before instantiating the client. Tags: [gcp_scc, cnapp, cloud-native-posture].
